_what: Lines the gate EXPECTS to see repeating (#2848). Each entry is a regex over the NORMALISED line (numbers -> N, timestamps -> T, shas -> H; see normaliseLine in repeating-lines.mjs -- so `a11ign` reads `aNign`) and carries the reason. An entry without a reason is refused at load.
_rule: Add an entry only for a line that is the org working as designed. A line that reports a fault is fixed or filed `ready`; it is never allowlisted to make the offer stop.

allow.reason: wake.mjs's report of an order whose seat is mid-turn (#3029): the queue waiting for a turn to end, which it exists to do. It is written until the seat is idle and carries its own age; past one hour (BUSY_SEAT_DEFERRAL_MS) the order is written as UNDELIVERED with the `nowhere to go` summary instead, and neither of those is allowlisted.

work the gate can see and is deliberately not offering (a declared blockedBy, Not-before, answer: or a file overlap with an open pull request). The line itself says it clears itself; 972 per day measured on 2026-10-01 and each is a row waiting on a field.
update-primary.mjs states where the checkout is on every tick it runs; it is a position reading, not a fault. A failed update prints a different line, which is not allowlisted.
npm's echo of the ExecStartPre command, written on every tick by npm itself.
systemd's per-run resource accounting line, written after every tick.
